conflict_robconflict.what: M2 conflict rows whose RoBERTa rule arm is also conflict

conflict_robnone.what: M2 conflict rows whose RoBERTa rule arm is none

agreement_robagreement_distinct.what: M2 agreement distinct segments whose RoBERTa rule arm is also agreement

agreement_robnone_distinct.what: M2 agreement distinct segments whose RoBERTa rule arm is none

conflict_p14speakers.what: M2 conflict rows, 138 Part 14 speakers only

agreement_distinct_p14speakers.what: M2 agreement distinct segments, 138 Part 14 speakers only

roberta_rule_arm: from part14_segments_sentiment.csv clearly_positive/clearly_negative by segment index: conflict = (label 1 and clearly_positive) or (label 0 and clearly_negative); agreement = the reverse; else none
prompt_verbatim: Based only on how this person's voice sounds, does this speaker show signs of depression? Answer with one word, Yes or No.
bootstrap: 2000 draws, fresh default_rng(0) per cell, speakers resampled with replacement, percentile 2.5/97.5
